name: Frappe Bench
postCreateCommand:
if [ "$FRAPPE_DEV_AGENTS" = 1 ]; then
  sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$CODEX_HOME" "$T3CODE_HOME"
  cd /workspace/development
  python installer.py --apps-json "$FRAPPE_APPS_JSON" --bench-name "$FRAPPE_BENCH_NAME" --site-name "$FRAPPE_SITE_NAME"
  cd "$FRAPPE_BENCH_NAME"
  uv pip freeze --python env/bin/python --exclude-editable > env/pre-commit-constraints.txt
  uv pip install --python env/bin/python --constraint env/pre-commit-constraints.txt pre-commit
  uv pip check --python env/bin/python
  npm install --global @openai/codex t3
  if [ -f /run/frappe-codex-auth.json ] && [ ! -e "$CODEX_HOME/auth.json" ]; then
    (umask 077; cp -n /run/frappe-codex-auth.json "$CODEX_HOME/auth.json")
  fi
else
  uv tool install pre-commit
fi
postStartCommand:
if [ "$FRAPPE_DEV_AGENTS" = 1 ]; then
  umask 077
  mkdir -p "$T3CODE_HOME/devcontainer"
  cd "/workspace/development/$FRAPPE_BENCH_NAME"
  . env/bin/activate
  nohup flock -n "$T3CODE_HOME/devcontainer/server.lock" t3 start --base-dir "$T3CODE_HOME" --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3773 --no-browser --auto-bootstrap-project-from-cwd >> "$T3CODE_HOME/devcontainer/server.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
  timeout 30 bash -c 'until curl --noproxy "*" -fs -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3773/; do sleep 1; done'
fi
